lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Sir, please — she has been waiting outside for twenty minutes. She is very, very angry.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I'm coming. I mean — I'm on my way down right now.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: You double-booked my suite. I flew fourteen hours for this. Fourteen!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ma'am, I'm so sorry. Please — give me one minute, and I will fix this.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة!... أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُم فِي Yalla Fluent.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: النَّهَارْدَه مَعَانَا مَاكَال فِي مَوْقِف صَعْب... كْلَايَنْت زَعْلَانَة جِدًّا، وَهُوَ لَازِم يِهَدِّي الدِّنْيَا بِالإِنْجِلِيزِي.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اِسْمَعُوا كْوَيِّس لِتَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات... I'm so sorry، وَ Let me fix this، وَ Just to confirm.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا... يِلَا نِتْعَلِّم وَنِتْسَلِّي!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ma'am, I'm so sorry about this. I've been checking your booking since I got the call. Please, come inside — let's sit down and I'll fix this.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Sit down? I don't want to sit down. I want my room. I booked the Palm Suite three weeks ago, and now your colleague tells me someone else is already inside.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I understand. You have every right to be upset. Just to confirm — your name is Ms. Hana, and the reservation is for four nights, yes?
lines.direction: steady, trying to slow things down

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Five nights. Five. And I live here since two years — no, wait, that's not the point. The point is I am tired and I have no room.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: You're right, and I'm sorry for the mix-up. Here's what I can do right now. We have a sea-view suite on the eighth floor. It's bigger than the Palm Suite, and I can offer it to you tonight at the same price.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: The same price? For a bigger suite? That... that sounds too good. Are you sure you can do that?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes, I'm sure. And I'll add free breakfast for your whole stay. If that works for you, I'll take you up myself and make sure everything is perfect.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Okay. Okay, fine. But if the room is not ready, I'm going to be very, very unhappy.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Deal. Give me two minutes — I'll confirm with the front desk, and then we'll go up together. Thank you for giving me the chance to fix this.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Two minutes. I'll wait here. And... thank you. Most people here just hand me a key and walk away.
lines.direction: quiet, a little surprised by the kindness

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب، يَا جَمَاعَة... مَاكَال عَمَلْ حَاجَة صَعْبَة جِدًّا: هَدَّى الدِّنْيَا بِالإِنْجِلِيزِي! خُدُوا بَالْكُمْ مِنْ تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات. أَوَّل وَاحِد: I'm so sorry. مَعْنَاهَا آسِف بِجِدّ... بِنِسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا الغَلْطَة كَبِيرَة، مِشْ زَيِّ I'm sorry العَادِيَّة. مَثَلًا: I'm so sorry about the delay.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي تَعْبِير: Let me fix this. يَعْنِي سِيبْنِي أَنَا أَصْلَحْ المَوْقِف. بِنِقُولْهَا لَمَّا الكْلَايَنْت زَعْلَان وِنِحْنَا عَايْزِين نِطَمْنَه. مَثَلًا: Please, give me one minute — let me fix this.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَالِت تَعْبِير: Just to confirm. يَعْنِي أَتْأَكَّد بَس. بِنِسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا نِعِيد المَعْلُومَة بُصُوغَة سُؤَال، عَشَان نِتَأَكَّد إِحْنَا فَاهْمِين صَح. مَثَلًا: Just to confirm — your name is Ms. Hana, yes?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالغَلْطَة المُشْتَرَكَة... وَلَا يِهِمَّك، كُلِّنَا بِنِعْمِلْهَا. المَصْرِي بِيِقُولْ I live here since two years، لِأَنَّ فِي العَرَبِي بِنِقُولْ "مِن سَنَتَيْن". بَسْ بِالإِنْجِلِيزِي الصَّح: I've lived here for two years.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي... Accent Lab! النَّهَارْدَه عَنْ اللِّينْكِينْغ. الأَمْرِيكَان بِيِوْصَلُوا الكَلِمَات بَعْض، مِشْ بِيِفْصَلُوهَا. مَثَلًا فِي الجُمْلَة: I'm on my way down... بْتُسْمَعْ كِدَه: I-mo-ny-way-down. جَرِّبْ مَعَايَا: I'm on my way. تَانِي مَرَّة: I'm on my way. بْرَافُو!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ms. Hana, your suite is ready. I checked it myself. The view from the eighth floor is honestly better than the Palm Suite.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: You checked it yourself? Okay... wow. That's good service. I've lived here for two years, and nobody ever did that for me.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Just to confirm — you'll have breakfast at eight, and I'll call you at seven to make sure everything is fine.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: That works. You know what, young man? You should meet my boss. She runs Rising Voices. She's always looking for people who stay calm when clients shout.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Rising Voices? I mean... that's the fellowship I applied for. Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Very serious. I'm calling her now. Her name is Nour's manager — Ms. Layla. She'll want a follow-up call tomorrow at nine. Can you handle that?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I can. I've handled worse tonight, right? Just to confirm — tomorrow, nine o'clock. I'll be ready.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Good. And Macal — fix that mix-up with the booking system. My boss hates double bookings even more than I do.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Noted. Let me fix this one thing first, and then... I have a call to prepare for.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب يَا جَمَاعَة... كَمَّلْنَا الحِكَايَة، وَمَاكَال طَلَع مِنْ المَوْقِف كَبِير! رَاجِعُوا مَعَايَا: I'm so sorry... لَمَّا الغَلْطَة كَبِيرَة، و Let me fix this... عَشَان نِطَمْنَه، و Just to confirm... لَمَّا نِتْأَكَّد إِحْنَا فَاهْمِين صَح.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة بِطُولْهَا... تِسْمَعُوا كِدَه: "Just to confirm." دِي المَفْتَاح! بِيِسْتَخْدِمْهَا الكُل، فِي الشُّغْل، فِي الحَيَاة، فِي أَي مَكَان. قُولُوهَا مَعَايَا... Just to confirm.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَقْتِي التَحَدِّي! سَجِّلُوا ڤويس نُوت صُغَيَّر، قُولُوا فِيه Just to confirm... وَوَرُّونَا اللِّينْكِينْغ بُتَاع النَّهَارْدَه.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَاتْخَافُوش مِنْ الغَلَط... إِحْنَا بِنِشَجِّع بَعْض! اِبْعَتُوا الفويس نُوت عَلَى تِلِجْرَام... Empire English Community. إِحْنَا مُسْتَخْطِرِين نِسْمَع صَوْتَك، وَنِشَجِّعَك!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَاشْطُر هُنَا بَقَى... فِي الحَلْقَة الجَايَة، مَاكَال عِنْدُه مُكَالْمَة مَع Ms. Layla بُتَاع Rising Voices. هَل حَيِقْدَر يِثْبِت نَفْسُه؟ مَا تِفُوتُوش! يَلَّا، فِلُوْنت!

phonetic_focus.note: Native speakers connect words: 'an apartment' -> 'a-napartment', 'pick it up' -> 'pi-ki-tup'. Words flow into each other.
